# The Spectrum Institute (TSI)

> The Spectrum Institute (TSI Spectrum) is an AI Engineering and IT academy in Swat, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan. It serves students from across Swat (Mingora, Saidu Sharif, Barikot, Kabal, Matta, Khwazakhela, Charbagh, Madyan, Bahrain, Kalam) from its main campus in Barikot and city campus in Mingora. It is best known for its Artificial Intelligence and computer courses: AI Engineering, Machine Learning, Data Science, Python, Cyber Security, Web & Software Development, CCNA and DIT/CIT. AI courses are led by Shah Mujeeb Ur Rahman, an AI specialist and AI security researcher. TSI also offers Safety Engineering (NEBOSH, IOSH, OSHA), academic coaching and language courses.
